jobs.title: Program Operations Manager (China–U.S. Drug Development)
jobs.description:
About Langlai Technology Langlai Technology is a biopharma company seeking a highly organized and execution-oriented Program Operations Manager to support the coordination and execution of multiple drug development programs across our China and U.S. organizations. Working closely with program leadership and cross-functional teams, this person will provide hands-on program and project management, maintain integrated timelines, coordinate communications and deliverables, and ensure consistent follow-through across functions and geographies. Key Responsibilities - Develop and maintain integrated project plans, timelines, milestone trackers, action-item lists, and decision logs for assigned programs. - Coordinate with functional owners to establish responsibilities and deadlines, monitor deliverables and dependencies, and track actions through completion. - Facilitate timely, accurate communication between China and U.S. teams across clinical development, clinical operations, regulatory, CMC, nonclinical, legal, finance, and external partners (CROs, vendors, consultants). - Coordinate program, partner, and cross-functional meetings: scheduling, agendas, pre-reads, meeting records, and follow-up on actions. - Coordinate document review cycles (protocols, regulatory documents, reports, presentations, contracts), version tracking, approvals, and finalization. - Track partner commitments, open questions, and data requests; escalate matters requiring scientific, regulatory, legal, commercial, or strategic judgment. - Prepare cross-program status summaries highlighting milestones, overdue actions, dependencies, risks, and decisions needed. Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, business, project management, or related field (master's preferred but not required). - 5 or more years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO drug-development environments preferred; strong candidates with fewer years will also be considered. - Hands-on experience in cross-functional project/program management or development coordination. - Practical understanding of drug development across clinical, regulatory, CMC, and nonclinical functions. - Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Chinese. - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing deadlines. - Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint). - Flexibility to participate in scheduled cross-time-zone meetings with China and U.S. teams. - PMP or other project management certification is a plus but not required.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:

##### **REQ#:****RQ229880**

##### **Requisition Type:****Regular**

##### **Your Impact**

Own your opportunity to be on the frontlines of health innovation. Deliver for America’s health agency missions and enhance lives for hundreds of millions every day.

**Job Description**
-------------------

GDIT has been supporting the IHS mission for 20+ years; working with the agency to provide integral services to raise health access and availability to 2.6 million American Indians and Alaska Natives. You'll be part of modernizing the Electronic Health Record (EHR) platform to enable better data access, patient experience, and quality of care for 567 tribes, 37 states and over 600 medical facilities.

  

Our work depends on a **Sr.** **Business Analyst** joining our team to support the **Indian Health Service (IHS) Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM)** program. As a Business Analyst supporting the IHS EHRM program, you will be responsible for supporting the PMO for contract management execution support.

  

**This position is fully remote.**

  

* Lead/Manage/Support:
  + Support KM and SharePoint operations across the program, ensuring consistent structure, organization, and accessibility.
  + Monitor, triage, and track KM tickets, coordinating resolution and maintaining visibility into progress.
  + Provide front-end SharePoint administration, including creating lists/libraries, designing modern pages, and managing permissions and groups (no back-end support required).
  + Support development of program asset documentation, including procedures, processes, templates, and structured KM artifacts.
  + Manage and coordinate the Lessons Learned process, tracking submissions, facilitating updates, and maintaining documentation.
  + Support GovSlack user administration, including account creation/removal and troubleshooting access issues.
* Collaborate with:
  + Partner with KM and functional teams to ensure timely ticket resolution and effective content governance.
  + Coordinate with content owners and SMEs during SharePoint content reviews to validate governance recommendations.
  + Engage members across the program to collect, document, and refine Lessons Learned inputs.
  + Work closely with content owners when identifying duplicate or abandoned SharePoint content and recommending cleanup actions.
* Drive:
  + Drive continuous improvement by identifying process gaps and recommending solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, and program performance.
  + Promote structured KM practices, ensuring consistent usage of templates, process documentation, and program assets.
  + Contribute to SharePoint governance maturity, helping the program maintain compliance, reduce content sprawl, and improve user experience.
  + Drive engagement in the Lessons Learned process by encouraging participation, coordinating input across teams, and promoting consistent use of Lessons Learned outputs to strengthen program operations.
* Utilize:
  + Utilize SharePoint Online**,** including document libraries, metadata tagging, lists, modern pages, and permission structures.
  + Leverage KM tools and workflows, such as program asset repositories, Lessons Learned trackers, and structured documentation systems.
  + Use communication and presentation tools to prepare and deliver clear briefings and updates to program audiences, including leadership.
  + Apply analytical skills, workflow assessment techniques, and structured documentation practices to strengthen program operations.

**Requirements:**

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
* Oracle Cerner certification may substitute for 3 years of required experience
* Experience with SharePoint (document libraries, metadata tagging, lists, permissions)
* Proven ability to document processes
* Experience supporting technical, clinical, or PMO teams
* Experience with supporting change management, reporting, and workflow tracking, determining issue resolution pathways/escalation, and tracking milestone progress during development and implementation phases
* Experience coordinating communication across functional teams
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the year, if needed
* Must be able to obtain a Public Trust Level 5 clearance
  

**Preferred:**

* Experience with GovSlack, Slack, or other team collaboration platforms
* Excellent written communication skills
* Experience working with ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems

* Experience supporting federal contract program manager

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
Personnel shall provide ASU project specific analytical support in the performance of ASU’s acquisition security mission. Personnel shall assist ASU in the vetting process for acquisitions. Personnel shall be expected to support meetings, draft and review documents, correspond with Government personnel and other vendors, and provide other related services in performance of this contract specifically in the areas of an Industrial Security Professional or Management and Program Analyst to include:
  
Plan, perform, facilitate, and assist with analyzing known and potential risks and threats directed at the Intelligence Community (IC), including but not limited to the FBI.
  
Conduct background research utilizing all available sources.
  
Attain or develop Company Key Management Personnel Listings (KMPL) as required.
  
Review and utilize IC Threat Matrix.
  
Assign Company Threat Scores.
  
Write Threat Assessments and related documents.
  
Utilize Resource Checklists.
  
Support the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and all related components.
  
,
  
Required Skills
  
  
Bachelor’s degree or demonstrate three (3) years professional experience utilizing analytical skills and writing ability to present viable alternatives and make professional recommendations.
  
Four (4) years demonstrated knowledge and application of NISPOM standards.
  
Two (2) years demonstrated knowledge and application of Executive Orders (EOs), Security Executive Agent Directives (SEADs), and Federal Investigative Standards (FISs) related to obtaining and maintaining a personnel security clearance.
  
Demonstrated experience in industrial security matters, pertinent national industrial security policies, directives, and programs.
  
Knowledge and experience in the use of Open Source research.
  
Must be willing and able to undergo a CI polygraph.
  
,
  
Desired Skills
  
  
FBI Experience
  
Experience in Intelligence Analysis
  
,
  
About A2 Federal
  
  
A2 Federal is dedicated to augmenting the United States' national security efforts, domestically and abroad. We specialize in intelligence, language, and information technology/cyber services to support the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, and other agencies across the federal government.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst with Active Top Secret or DHS Clearance
jobs.description:
**Job Type:** Hybrid

**Job Location:** Ashburn, VA

**Categories:** Program / Project Management

InDev is seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst preparing to transition into a Deputy Project Manager role. This professional combines a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes with technical fluency to translate operational needs into actionable requirements and implementation plans. Serving as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, they support solution delivery, stakeholder communication, risk and issue management, project planning, team coordination, and delivery oversight while developing the leadership capabilities needed to deputize for the Project Manager.

This position is intended for a high-performing Senior Business Analyst who is ready to broaden their accountability beyond analysis and assume progressively greater ownership of project delivery. With demonstrated success, the individual will have the opportunity to transition into a Deputy Project Manager role and serve as a reliable extension of the Project Manager across planning, execution, governance, and stakeholder leadership.

**YOUR FUTURE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead discovery, requirements elicitation, process analysis, and solution-definition activities across complex initiatives.
* Translate business objectives and identify operational challenges into clear business needs and detailed requirements and trackable success metrics.
* Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, functional requirements, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Create and document functional test cases to verify functionality delivered meets business needs.
* Execute functional tests and document results with traceability.
* Evaluate proposed solutions for business fit, feasibility, operational impact, scalability, and alignment with project objectives.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with business leaders, subject-matter experts, product owners, architects, developers, testers, and operational teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability and support backlog refinement, solution design, testing, deployment readiness, and post-implementation review.
* Identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend practical changes to workflows, controls, systems, and operating procedures.
* Support project planning, scheduling, dependency management, resource coordination, status reporting, and milestone tracking.
* Monitor risks, issues, assumptions, and decisions; coordinate follow-up actions and escalate concerns when appropriate.
* Prepare clear communications, executive briefings, and decision materials for project leadership and stakeholders.
* Act on behalf of the Project Manager when delegated, helping maintain delivery momentum, team alignment, and stakeholder confidence.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* U.S. Citizen; Active DHS clearance or Top-Secret Clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or other related discipline.
* Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in business analysis, process improvement, requirements management, or technology-enabled transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business processes and convert stakeholder needs into well-structured requirements and delivery plans.
* Working knowledge of the software or systems delivery lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders in a cross-functional project environment.
* Strong facilitation, written communication, presentation, problem-solving, and decision-support skills.
* Experience supporting project plans, risks, issues, dependencies, status reporting, and governance activities.
* Proficiency in tools including Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office Suite.

**NICE TO HAVES**

* Experience serving as a workstream lead, project lead, Scrum Master, product owner, or deputy to a Project Manager.
* Familiarity with Agile, hybrid, and traditional project delivery methods.
* Proficiency with requirements, process-mapping, collaboration, reporting, or project-management tools.
* Relevant business analysis, Agile, process improvement, or project management certification.

**Clearance:** U.S. Citizen; Active DHS clearance or Top Secret Clearance.

**WHY INDEV**

* **Innovative Environment:** Join a team that thrives on creativity and innovation, where your ideas are not only heard but encouraged.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Contribute to projects that directly impact federal agencies, driving positive change on a national scale.
* **Dynamic Collaboration:** Work alongside diverse experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and making a difference.
* **Agile Mindset:** Embrace Agile methodologies that encourage flexibility, adaptability, and rapid growth.
* **Learning Culture:** Enjoy ongoing learning opportunities and professional development to expand your skill set.
* **Cutting-edge Tech:** Engage with the latest technologies and tools in the data integration landscape.

If you’re ready to embark on a journey of innovation, collaboration, and impact, InDev welcomes you to join our team. Let’s shape the future together.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**

3Gi Technology is looking for an Infrastructure Project Manager to plan and deliver IT infrastructure projects across the business. The role reports to the Head of IT Transformation.

Projects include data centre, cloud, network, end-user computing, security and supplier-led work. The main aim is to deliver change on time and within budget, with as little disruption to the business as possible, while meeting security and compliance standards.

The role works closely with Technology leadership, the infrastructure and security teams, business stakeholders and third-party vendors.

**Responsibilities**

Project delivery

* Managing infrastructure projects from start to finish, including planning, delivery, testing, cutover and closure
* Keeping project plans, schedules, RAID logs and status reports up to date
* Managing dependencies between infrastructure, security, applications and business teams
* Coordinating internal teams and external suppliers
* Handing completed projects over to BAU support

Stakeholders and governance

* Main point of contact for infrastructure change projects
* Giving clear, non-technical updates to senior stakeholders
* Preparing reports for steering committees and other governance meetings
* Following internal change, risk and security approval processes
* Raising risks and issues early, with mitigation plans

Vendor and commercial

* Managing third-party vendors and suppliers
* Making sure suppliers deliver to contract, timelines and quality standards
* Helping with procurement, including scope, vendor selection and cost estimates
* Tracking budgets against actual spend

Risk, security and compliance

* Making sure projects meet security and regulatory requirements such as GDPR, Cyber Essentials and FCA controls where relevant
* Arranging security reviews and penetration testing when needed
* Making sure resilience and disaster recovery are included in project designs

Improvement

* Improving project templates, standards and reporting
* Helping reduce technical debt and improve system stability
* Supporting the infrastructure roadmap with Technology leadership

**Requirements**

Essential

* Experience delivering IT infrastructure projects (on-prem, cloud or hybrid)
* Good knowledge of networks, servers, cloud platforms, end-user computing and security
* Experience managing third-party vendors and systems integrators
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills
* Knowledge of project management methods (Waterfall, Agile or hybrid)
* Experience working in a regulated or security-focused environment

Desirable

* Cloud migration or large infrastructure change projects
* Experience with information security, identity or resilience projects
* Budget tracking and business case experience
* Experience working with steering committees
* PRINCE2, PMP or similar certification

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with an up-to-date CV.

Pay: £32,000.00-£42,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Live Sports Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Apex Logic Lab is a small experimental technology lab focused on understanding sports through reliable data infrastructure and machine learning. The team builds systems that transform real-time information from live events into clearer, more actionable views of games for partners and clients. Working at Apex Logic Lab offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge tools that support analysis, performance insights, and fan experiences. Team members collaborate closely in a fast-paced environment where innovation, accuracy, and curiosity about sports and technology are highly valued.

**Role Description**

The Live Sports Data Analyst is a contract, on-site at games role based in the London area. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. The role also involves collaborating with data engineers and analysts to improve data collection processes, participating in training sessions to refine methods, and following strict quality and timing protocols. This position may require evening and weekend work aligned with live sports schedules.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Data Collection skills with attention to detail and accuracy in fast-paced, real-time environments.
* Analytical Skills to interpret game situations, validate data, and recognize patterns or inconsistencies.
* Clear Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and follow operational guidelines.
* Experience with Training and Research to learn new tools quickly, apply standardized methods, and contribute to process improvements.
* Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events.
* Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting.
* Ability to work on-site in the London area, including evenings and weekends as available.
* Previous experience in sports statistics, live event operations, or a related data-focused field is beneficial; relevant education in fields such as sports management, statistics, or computer science is a plus.
* **Applicants with a Premier League club membership are strongly preferred.** If you are a member, please indicate your club affiliation on your résumé.
* Selected candidates will be contacted via Whatsapp

**Pay**  
We pay a base of $200 per Premier League match, plus a performance bonus up to $200.

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Analyst - US Government Security
jobs.description:
**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

### **The Role**

As an Operations Analyst supporting our US Government teams, you keep the mission moving by tracking and stabilizing projects, removing roadblocks, owning operational outcomes, and staying two steps ahead so the team can focus on what they do best.  
  
This role demands a varying range of responsibilities; you could be managing a classified facility and vendors one hour and scoping process improvement initiatives the next. You're a first-responder by instinct, a systems thinker by habit, someone who finds order in ambiguity, sees friction as a problem worth solving and shows up everyday with a *Get Things Done* mentality. Communication and attention to detail are core to how you operate, not afterthoughts.  
  
You'll be part of a high-accountability, high-expectation team that is just as invested in each other's success as they are in Palantir's mission. Feedback isn't just welcomed here, it's how we get better.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first-responder for technical and non-technical issues, troubleshooting and resolving challenges with a solutions-first mindset.
* Own and manage all aspects of facility operations, from desk configurations and IT setups to HVAC and COMSEC, coordinating across internal teams and external vendors to keep the environment running at a unified high standard.
* Support the team and project delivery by identifying and reducing bottlenecks, blockers, or friction.
* Craft and implement processes or tools to reduce friction and optimally utilize resources.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst with Active Top Secret or DHS Clearance
new_jobs.description:
**Job Type:** Hybrid

**Job Location:** Ashburn, VA

**Categories:** Program / Project Management

InDev is seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst preparing to transition into a Deputy Project Manager role. This professional combines a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes with technical fluency to translate operational needs into actionable requirements and implementation plans. Serving as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, they support solution delivery, stakeholder communication, risk and issue management, project planning, team coordination, and delivery oversight while developing the leadership capabilities needed to deputize for the Project Manager.

This position is intended for a high-performing Senior Business Analyst who is ready to broaden their accountability beyond analysis and assume progressively greater ownership of project delivery. With demonstrated success, the individual will have the opportunity to transition into a Deputy Project Manager role and serve as a reliable extension of the Project Manager across planning, execution, governance, and stakeholder leadership.

**YOUR FUTURE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead discovery, requirements elicitation, process analysis, and solution-definition activities across complex initiatives.
* Translate business objectives and identify operational challenges into clear business needs and detailed requirements and trackable success metrics.
* Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, functional requirements, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Create and document functional test cases to verify functionality delivered meets business needs.
* Execute functional tests and document results with traceability.
* Evaluate proposed solutions for business fit, feasibility, operational impact, scalability, and alignment with project objectives.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with business leaders, subject-matter experts, product owners, architects, developers, testers, and operational teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability and support backlog refinement, solution design, testing, deployment readiness, and post-implementation review.
* Identify process-improvement opportunities and recommend practical changes to workflows, controls, systems, and operating procedures.
* Support project planning, scheduling, dependency management, resource coordination, status reporting, and milestone tracking.
* Monitor risks, issues, assumptions, and decisions; coordinate follow-up actions and escalate concerns when appropriate.
* Prepare clear communications, executive briefings, and decision materials for project leadership and stakeholders.
* Act on behalf of the Project Manager when delegated, helping maintain delivery momentum, team alignment, and stakeholder confidence.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* U.S. Citizen; Active DHS clearance or Top-Secret Clearance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or other related discipline.
* Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in business analysis, process improvement, requirements management, or technology-enabled transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business processes and convert stakeholder needs into well-structured requirements and delivery plans.
* Working knowledge of the software or systems delivery lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Experience collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders in a cross-functional project environment.
* Strong facilitation, written communication, presentation, problem-solving, and decision-support skills.
* Experience supporting project plans, risks, issues, dependencies, status reporting, and governance activities.
* Proficiency in tools including Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office Suite.

**NICE TO HAVES**

* Experience serving as a workstream lead, project lead, Scrum Master, product owner, or deputy to a Project Manager.
* Familiarity with Agile, hybrid, and traditional project delivery methods.
* Proficiency with requirements, process-mapping, collaboration, reporting, or project-management tools.
* Relevant business analysis, Agile, process improvement, or project management certification.

**Clearance:** U.S. Citizen; Active DHS clearance or Top Secret Clearance.

**WHY INDEV**

* **Innovative Environment:** Join a team that thrives on creativity and innovation, where your ideas are not only heard but encouraged.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Contribute to projects that directly impact federal agencies, driving positive change on a national scale.
* **Dynamic Collaboration:** Work alongside diverse experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and making a difference.
* **Agile Mindset:** Embrace Agile methodologies that encourage flexibility, adaptability, and rapid growth.
* **Learning Culture:** Enjoy ongoing learning opportunities and professional development to expand your skill set.
* **Cutting-edge Tech:** Engage with the latest technologies and tools in the data integration landscape.

If you’re ready to embark on a journey of innovation, collaboration, and impact, InDev welcomes you to join our team. Let’s shape the future together.

new_jobs.title: Infrastructure Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About the role**

3Gi Technology is looking for an Infrastructure Project Manager to plan and deliver IT infrastructure projects across the business. The role reports to the Head of IT Transformation.

Projects include data centre, cloud, network, end-user computing, security and supplier-led work. The main aim is to deliver change on time and within budget, with as little disruption to the business as possible, while meeting security and compliance standards.

The role works closely with Technology leadership, the infrastructure and security teams, business stakeholders and third-party vendors.

**Responsibilities**

Project delivery

* Managing infrastructure projects from start to finish, including planning, delivery, testing, cutover and closure
* Keeping project plans, schedules, RAID logs and status reports up to date
* Managing dependencies between infrastructure, security, applications and business teams
* Coordinating internal teams and external suppliers
* Handing completed projects over to BAU support

Stakeholders and governance

* Main point of contact for infrastructure change projects
* Giving clear, non-technical updates to senior stakeholders
* Preparing reports for steering committees and other governance meetings
* Following internal change, risk and security approval processes
* Raising risks and issues early, with mitigation plans

Vendor and commercial

* Managing third-party vendors and suppliers
* Making sure suppliers deliver to contract, timelines and quality standards
* Helping with procurement, including scope, vendor selection and cost estimates

Risk, security and compliance

* Arranging security reviews and penetration testing when needed
* Making sure resilience and disaster recovery are included in project designs

Improvement

* Improving project templates, standards and reporting
* Helping reduce technical debt and improve system stability
* Supporting the infrastructure roadmap with Technology leadership

**Requirements**

Essential

* Experience delivering IT infrastructure projects (on-prem, cloud or hybrid)
* Good knowledge of networks, servers, cloud platforms, end-user computing and security
* Experience managing third-party vendors and systems integrators
* Good stakeholder management and communication skills
* Knowledge of project management methods (Waterfall, Agile or hybrid)
* Experience working in a regulated or security-focused environment

Desirable

* Cloud migration or large infrastructure change projects
* Experience with information security, identity or resilience projects
* Budget tracking and business case experience
* Experience working with steering committees
* PRINCE2, PMP or similar certification

Apply through Indeed with an up-to-date CV.

Pay: £32,000.00-£42,000.00 per year

**Company Description**

Apex Logic Lab is a small experimental technology lab focused on understanding sports through reliable data infrastructure and machine learning. The team builds systems that transform real-time information from live events into clearer, more actionable views of games for partners and clients. Working at Apex Logic Lab offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge tools that support analysis, performance insights, and fan experiences. Team members collaborate closely in a fast-paced environment where innovation, accuracy, and curiosity about sports and technology are highly valued.

**Role Description**

The Live Sports Data Analyst is a contract, on-site at games role based in the London area. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. The role also involves collaborating with data engineers and analysts to improve data collection processes, participating in training sessions to refine methods, and following strict quality and timing protocols. This position may require evening and weekend work aligned with live sports schedules.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Data Collection skills with attention to detail and accuracy in fast-paced, real-time environments.
* Analytical Skills to interpret game situations, validate data, and recognize patterns or inconsistencies.
* Clear Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and follow operational guidelines.
* Experience with Training and Research to learn new tools quickly, apply standardized methods, and contribute to process improvements.
* Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events.
* Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting.
* Ability to work on-site in the London area, including evenings and weekends as available.
* Previous experience in sports statistics, live event operations, or a related data-focused field is beneficial; relevant education in fields such as sports management, statistics, or computer science is a plus.
* **Applicants with a Premier League club membership are strongly preferred.** If you are a member, please indicate your club affiliation on your résumé.
* Selected candidates will be contacted via Whatsapp

**Pay**  
We pay a base of $200 per Premier League match, plus a performance bonus up to $200.

Work Location: In person
